I recently saw a price list for the White Wolf/WoTC Jyhad game.
Everything has gone up. They retail for:

$8.95 for a starter pack  ($89.50 for a case - 10 packs)
$2.75 for a booster pack  ($99.00 for a case - 36 packs)

The store I go to told me that they were going to sell the starters
for $80 a case (10%) and the boosters for $85 a case (14%). 

If you think thats a good price you should call them up by Thursday
4:30pm at the LATEST!! These are pre-orders so you should be able to
obtain all the cards you order if you order by 4:30pm Thursday.

Anna's Collectibles & Antiques
(914) 878-4544

Disclaimer: I am an no way affiliated with AC&A. Since I notice on the
            net many undiscounted prices I am hoping that others may
            benefit from their usual discounted prices as I do.
